ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISBLANK( Case_Resolution__c ) , ISBLANK( Root_Cause_Analysis__c ) , ISBLANK( TEXT(Type) )) && IsClosed && ISPICKVAL(Reason , 'Issue') && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type , 'Record Deletion')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type , 'User Management')) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Case Reason is Issue you must complete the Case Resolution, Root Cause Analysis, and Type fields before closing the case.
